text_block_list.text:
While spending my day off at a campsite, I 
happened upon a familiar pair.
choice_data_list:
Fancy meeting you two here. Having a 
barbecue?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a coincidence! We're here for a 
hike.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Just the other day—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, if you ever need help again, just 
let me know. I'd be glad to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to visit a nature park this 
coming weekend? There is something I wish 
to show you.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
An outing invited by Zephyr sounded so 
exciting that I ended up waking up way too 
early.
choice_data_list: Haha, sounds fun. Have a safe trip!
Fufu, sounds fun. Have a safe trip!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san, look over there. It is the 
little ladle bird. Such a lovely song, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, a long-tailed tit! Fufu, it's so 
tiny and adorable.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This must be a wonderful habitat for them. 
I can feel the presence of many other 
birds besides the long-tailed tits.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The forest is a splendid home. Just 
ahead lies their play area as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The breeze sweeping across the water's 
surface feels so gentle. This is where the 
ladle birds come to play in the water.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... amazing! I can clearly see even 
the smallest pebbles at the bottom of the 
river...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's not just stones. Take a peek 
into the shadows behind the rocky crags. 
You'll find some little sneaks hiding 
there.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Little sneaks...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean trout! Ahaha, they really do 
look like they're sneaking around. You 
sure are good at coming up with clever 
names, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This place makes you feel so much vibrant 
life. Just being here gives me energy... 
or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now that you've received vitality, 
next comes peace of mind. After all, this 
is a place that can bestow both upon you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is... one of my special, treasured 
spots. Fufu, a sunlit meadow, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... I had no idea there was such 
an open grassy meadow here! Running 
here... would feel so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Running while taking in the scent of 
grass and trees is truly exceptional. 
However, before that... would you care to 
lie down for a while?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Gazing up only at the sky and sunlight 
filtering through the trees, surrendering 
yourself to the south wind... how does 
that sound...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It feels so mysterious. Even the gentle 
rustling sound of wind brushing through 
grass...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...*yawn*... Somehow, I'm feeling 
sleepy... ............

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... sorry. The breeze felt so 
soothing, I accidentally dozed off.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, though, my head feels 
completely clear. It's been so long since 
I had such a relaxing day off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in that case... I am truly glad I 
invited you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Those kind hands I see before me are 
always reaching out for the sake of 
others. However――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No matter how kind a person is, they 
sometimes need to smile merrily and find 
peace for their own sake too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If Miracle-san is a bird that flies for 
others, then I... can at least serve as 
your resting branch.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Without even realizing it... I was being 
watched over by such a grand, gentle tree, 
wasn't I...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Thanks to you, I feel like I 
can fly with all my heart going forward.

Yamanin Zephyr and KS Miracle returned 
from their hike.
choice_data_list:
Welcome back. If you'd like... want to eat 
with us?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is it really alright? In that case, we'll 
gladly take you up on the offer. Getting 
to enjoy a barbecue at the very end makes 
this the absolute best day off, fufu.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, my stomach was already 
growling. I might end up eating a lot more 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Let us hold nothing back, and become 
a tempest to feast.
